description: Defines the class interface for VertexArrayGL, a class managing OpenGL vertex array objects within the ANGLE project. Contains class declarations, member functions, and private data members related to OpenGL vertex array state management.

classes.name: VertexArrayGL
classes.description: OpenGL-specific implementation of a vertex array object, managing vertex attribute and buffer state, and interfacing with OpenGL functions.

methods.name: VertexArrayGL
methods.description: Constructor initializing the VertexArrayGL object with vertex array state, functions, and state manager.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the vertex array object within a given context.

methods.name: syncDrawElementsState
methods.description: Synchronizes the state needed for drawing elements.

methods.name: getVertexArrayID
methods.description: Returns the OpenGL ID of the vertex array object.

methods.name: getAppliedElementArrayBufferID
methods.description: Returns the ID of the applied element array buffer.

methods.name: syncState
methods.description: Synchronizes the internal state with the OpenGL state based on dirty bits.

methods.name: applyNumViewsToDivisor
methods.description: Sets the number of views for vertex attribute divisor.

methods.name: applyActiveAttribLocationsMask
methods.description: Applies a mask to active attribute locations.

methods.name: validateState
methods.description: Validates the current state for correctness.
